title: DojoLiq Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Watermelon Ice is the perfect companion for a refreshing, all-day vape. The inhale captures the lush, aqueous sweetness of crisp red Watermelon, providing a light and deeply authentic fruit base. To complete the experience, a smooth breeze of frosty Ice arrives on the exhale, chilling the tropical notes and leaving the palate feeling thoroughly refreshed. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
